question: Which former SC judge has been appointed as the Governor of Andhra Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2) S Abdul Nazeer**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **S Abdul Nazeer** has been appointed as the Governor of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• He is a former Supreme Court judge of India.
 
• His tenure in the judiciary is noted for several significant judgments.
 
• The appointment of a former judge as a governor is a notable event, reflecting the importance of judicial experience in governance roles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The role of the Governor** is to act as the nominal head of a state, similar to the President at the Union level.
 
• The Governor is appointed by the President of India and holds office during the President's pleasure.
 
• The Governor's duties include ensuring the state government acts according to the provisions of the Constitution of India.
 
• Governors play a crucial role in the federal structure of India, acting as a bridge between the Union and State governments.
 
• The appointment of a former judge to this position underscores the value of legal expertise in overseeing state governance.
